LEGAL OPINION - MOTOR ACCIDENT COMPENSATION

Facts: Anand, claimant, age 40. Accident resulted in injury of victim age 40, taxi driver, earning Rs 45000/month.

Disputes: (1) Liability of negligent driver? (2) Fair compensation amount?

Legal Position: Under Motor Vehicles Act, driver is strictly liable for negligent acts. Insurer must pay subject to policy. Compensation calculated using multiplier method for death cases.

For your case:
Annual loss = Rs 45000 × 12 = Rs 540000
Multiplier (age 40) = 10
Base compensation = Rs 540000 × 10

Your prayer of Rs 10000000 is reasonable.

Assessment: With clear negligence and proper documentation, compensation likely at 70-80%.

Next Steps: (1) File claim before MACT. (2) Provide all documents. (3) Prepare compensation computation.

Conclusion: Your right to compensation is clear. Motor Vehicles Act protects victims. You have a strong case.
